newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex aims for 10 pct profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Vendex aims for 10 pct profit growth.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Tuesday it still aimed to increase its operating profit by at least 10 percent annually.
"We stick to our aim to increase the operating profit - excluding real estate activities - by at least 10 percent annually," Vendex said in a statement.
The group said earlier that its 1996/97 total net profit rose 30 percent to a record 539 million guilders.
"Costs, excluding further acquisitions, will increase slightly," Vendex said.
Vendex said that due to the recent sell-off of the remaining stake in Barnes & Noble it would earn a substantional profit during the current year.
On March 24, Vendex said it was planning to sell all its remaining 1.82 million shares in Barnes & Noble.
Vendex said it expected an increase in tax payments.
